name: high-score
description: Reach the HIGH-SCORE NAME ENTRY screen (game over with a qualifying score) and pixel-validate the score-insertion and name-entry render vs MAME.
_grounding: Same game-over recipe (lives 0xAD00/0xAD10=1 @650, forced death 0xA800=0xF0 @660) PLUS a held score poke 0xAD33/34/35 = 00/57/00 (5700 BCD, beats the default table-low 4300) from f640. At f1134 the insertion sort (isScoreBelow 0x4d2b + fileScoreIntoHighTable 0x4cc3) files 5700 into the last table record at 0xAB28, and name entry holds ~680 frames. Responded uses the FILED score mid-byte 0xAB2A (0x43 default -> 0x57 only once the game files the poked score); the grounding's 0xAB2F==0xF1 is weak (the default record already ends in 0xF1). Deterministic, no entropy. scratchpad/gameover-recipe.md.
